# desktop-automation

macOS 桌面自动化：运行 AppleScript 控制应用程序。

## 调用

```bash
python3 skills/desktop-automation/run.py run --script 'tell application "Finder" to activate'
python3 skills/desktop-automation/run.py open_app --app Safari
```
